page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.t5-lc1m1.small is an entry-level, burstable virtual machine instance based on the KVM hypervisor. It features a single vCPU powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 1.0 GiB of system memory, providing a 1:1 ratio of memory to vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate that this instance is designed for low-intensity workloads. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU performance scores are both 1064.79, placing it in the lower tier of tested hardware. Memory bandwidth tests show 76.47 GB/sec for cached small blocks, dropping to 8.43 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 6.75 GB/sec for large block writes. The Passmark CPU score is 1212.67, and the instance achieves 1.34 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks, alongside a static web serving throughput of 1.28 GB/sec.

Due to its burstable CPU allocation and minimal resource footprint, this instance offers a highly cost-efficient profile for workloads that remain idle or run at low baseline utilization with occasional processing spikes. It is suited for lightweight applications such as microservices, basic development or testing environments, low-traffic static web serving, and simple automation scripts that do not require sustained high CPU performance or local storage.
